Subject: Opportunity truthing batch — please verify stages & close dates

Hi team,

Finance asked for a quick truthing pass on a batch of deals that are currently in our Nov–Dec close window. I pulled 18 opportunities flagged as "at-risk/aging" in the SF view and attached the CSV (opportunity-batch-list.csv). Ask is light and time-boxed: please do the following by EOD Monday (11/16):

- For each deal you own, confirm one of: Commit / Commit (but contingent) / No-go / Move to Prospecting.
- If Commit, update close date to the nearest realistic date and attach any supporting evidence (SOW, PO, signed email).
- If No-go, add a 1-line rationale and set Stage=Closed Lost with loss reason.

I assigned a tentative owner column in the CSV where available — please reassign if needed. Important: finance wants to finalize the forecast rollup on Tuesday morning.

Quick notes on a couple of deals:
- Brightleaf Medical (BLM-8142): Lindsay is on the CC. Buyer asked to finalize SOW and routing; procurement looped in.
- HelixCare pilot: Marcus, this one had a technical gating item last week — please confirm status.

Attachments: opportunity-batch-list.csv (CSV with 18 rows).

Thanks — short, sharp, and decisive.

—Naomi
